name: Pulp
description: Pulp still in the vat: fibres pulling the edge of every shape out of line.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 6; scale: 0.92); clip-path: @shape(points: 6; scale: 0.92); filter: @svg-filter(feTurbulence { type: fractalNoise; baseFrequency: 0.05; numOctaves: 2; seed: 11 } feDisplacementMap { in: SourceGraphic; scale: 14 }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
